_meta.description: Base date: 2024-08-26 00:00:00 UTC. Message timestamps are offsets in ms from this base. Covers roughly 3-4 days of conversation between the current user (Adnan) and Mehvish. When phase 17 wires the real backend, whichever timestamp format AppSync uses will replace this fixture entirely.

messages.text: Assalamu Alaikum! I saw your profile on Knotify — hope you don't mind me saying hello.
Wa Alaikum Assalam Mehvish! Not at all, lovely to hear from you. How are you doing?
Alhamdulillah, really well thank you. I noticed you're based in Mannheim — what's it like there?
It's a lovely city — very multicultural, good food scene. Are you enjoying Hamburg?
Hamburg is beautiful, especially along the Alster. I moved here for my MSc two years ago and just stayed after getting the job at Clinic Nord.
Biomedical engineering sounds fascinating. What kind of projects are you working on right now?
Mostly medical device testing and regulatory submissions. It's detail-heavy work but I really enjoy it. What about you — software engineering must keep you busy too!
Ha, definitely never a dull moment. I work mainly on backend systems — distributed architecture, that sort of thing. Keeps the brain busy.
That sounds really impressive mashAllah. Do you enjoy it, or is it one of those jobs that feels like work?
Honestly I enjoy it most of the time. The problem-solving aspect keeps it fresh. What do you like to do outside of work?
I love reading — mostly non-fiction, science and history. I also try to keep up with fitness, gym three times a week inshAllah. You?
Same on the gym front! I also enjoy cooking — I find it relaxing after a long day in front of the screen.
A man who can cook — that's a rare find! What's your go-to dish?
Probably daal makhani — slow cooked for a couple of hours. Simple but it always comes out well.
Oh that sounds delicious! My mum's recipe is unbeatable but I've been trying to learn it. Maybe a cook-off one day! 😄
Ha, challenge accepted! On a more serious note — are you open to meeting in person at some point, perhaps in a family setting?
Yes, inshAllah. I think that would be a good next step. I'd want my parents involved from the start — I hope that's okay.
Absolutely, that's exactly how I'd want to do it too. Let me speak to my family and we can arrange something. JazakAllah khair Mehvish.
